# Miranda Rae Photography

> Affordable Florida Gulf Coast beach photographer. Miranda Rae photographs families, couples, maternity, engagements, proposals and small beach weddings in a relaxed, lightly guided style. Every session is shot and edited by Miranda personally.

- Website: https://mirandaraephotography.com/
- Photographer: Miranda Rae
- Email: bookmirandarae@gmail.com
- Phone/text: (448) 219-6539
- Portfolio: https://mirandaraesphotography.mypixieset.com/gallery-1/
- Facebook (16 reviews, 96% recommend): https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61591669718246

## Service areas
Mexico Beach, Port St. Joe, Cape San Blas, Indian Pass, Panama City Beach, Destin, and 30A (Santa Rosa Beach, Seaside, Rosemary Beach, WaterColor), Florida.

## Prices
- Beach Mini Session — $130: 30 minutes, 15 edited photos, up to 6 people. Mexico Beach, Port St. Joe, Cape San Blas and Panama City Beach. Sunrise, midday or sunset. Last-minute sessions are sometimes available — text to ask.
- Destin & 30A Session — $199: 30 minutes, 25 edited photos, up to 11 people.
- Beach Wedding Photography — $499: up to 4 hours, ceremony, family photos and shoreline portraits.
- All sessions include a private online gallery.

## Booking
Checking a date is free with no payment required. Send your beach and dates through the form at https://mirandaraephotography.com/#check-date and Miranda replies personally to confirm availability, meeting spot and time.
